response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT cu.gender AS gender, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Invoices i JOIN Orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id JOIN Customers cu ON o.customer_id = cu.customer_id GROUP BY cu.gender), s AS (SELECT gender, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM c) AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT s.gender, s.cnt AS count, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS share_minus_avg FROM s, a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share
